corHash API

Hash tables for the stack: chained, with the hash and compare functions the caller supplies, their items allocated from a corAlloc arena.

Below: every header of corHash at c54a223e - 2 headers, 13 entries, each with its declarations as written and its comment. Included as "corHash/<header>".

CorHashListItem

typedef	struct CorHashListItem
{
  void*                  data;
  struct CorHashListItem*  next;
  unsigned int           hashCode;   // Cached hash code for fast comparison
} CorHashListItem;

CorHashTable

typedef struct CorHashTable
{
  CorHashListItem**     array;
  int                   arraySize;
  unsigned int          mask;             // For power-of-2 sizes: arraySize-1, else 0
  CorHashCodeFunction   hashCodeFunction;
  CorHashCompareFunction  compareFunction;
  CorAlloc*             kallocP;
} CorHashTable;
